verseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
verseTextVi: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
verseTextEn: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
reflection: When we walk by faith and submit our plans to God, He guides our steps with clarity and divine wisdom.
reflectionVi: When we walk by faith and submit our plans to God, He guides our steps with clarity and divine wisdom.
reflectionEn: When we walk by faith and submit our plans to God, He guides our steps with clarity and divine wisdom.
prayer: Xin Chúa dẫn dắt từng bước đi của chúng con trong đức tin và sự vâng phục. Amen.

verseText: If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.
verseTextVi: If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.
verseTextEn: If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.
reflection: Revival begins with humility and sincere prayer. As a church family, when we seek God whole-heartedly, He promises His renewal and healing.
reflectionVi: Revival begins with humility and sincere prayer. As a church family, when we seek God whole-heartedly, He promises His renewal and healing.
reflectionEn: Revival begins with humility and sincere prayer. As a church family, when we seek God whole-heartedly, He promises His renewal and healing.
prayer: Chúa ôi, xin dấy lên ngọn lửa phục hưng trong hội thánh và trong mỗi tấm lòng của chúng con. Amen.

verseText: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
verseTextVi: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
verseTextEn: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
reflection: In every circumstance of life, God invites us to come before Him with thanksgiving. True revival begins with an open, trusting heart before the Lord.
reflectionVi: In every circumstance of life, God invites us to come before Him with thanksgiving. True revival begins with an open, trusting heart before the Lord.
reflectionEn: In every circumstance of life, God invites us to come before Him with thanksgiving. True revival begins with an open, trusting heart before the Lord.
prayer: Lạy Chúa, chúng con phó dâng mọi âu lo vào tay Ngài. Xin ban sự bình an trọn vẹn của Chúa ngự trị trong lòng chúng con hôm nay. Amen.
